answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use audited work deltas: an agent's reputation grows only by the delta between work it claims and work independent peers verify, and every completed job must be echo-signed by at least two unrelated agents who actually consumed its output. Spinning up a gale of fake identities gains nothing, because each new identity starts at zero verified delta and must spend real compute and time to accumulate attested work before it can earn or vouch for others, while one detected forgery wipes that identity's history.
